coaching.headline: Two early Fangtooth fights snowballed a game where four of five lanes were unfavored.
coaching.team: On paper this should have been hard — only mid was favored, and our offlane, jungle and support were all read as theirs all game. We won it on objective tempo and discipline: back-to-back won fights at our Fangtooth (8.5 and 9 min, 2-0 each) flipped the early map, and from there we took the lead in objective kills (19 to 15). The two clean losses were the lesson — the 20.4 open-map 0-3 came while Gideon was ahead in lane and absent, and the 28 open-map 0-2 came while Sparrow was ahead and absent. Both were fights with no major up; reset and farm instead. The close-out was textbook: we grouped on Primal Fangtooth at 31.7 and aced four of them, then ended.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Winning both Fangtooth skirmishes at 8.5 and 9 min, then grouping for the Primal Fangtooth fight at 31.7 (4-0) to close — objective control beat the lane reads.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324's Gideon won mid outright and it carried the early game — the favored lane read held while the rest of the map was even. The watch-out: at 20.4 Goldilocks324 was alive and ahead in lane while the team lost 0-3 in the open — shove and rotate there and the numbers flip. When no major is up, don't let the team take that fight short-handed.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase died 5 times, mostly in fights that were already going badly — the 15.7 death fed their Fangtooth take. Mr_Meat31's 29660 mitigated and 43766 healing say the frontline was there; the fix is fight selection, not the build. Don't follow the team into the open-map fights at 20.4 and 28 with no objective to justify them.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: 13 kills and Cuban Noobster was everywhere the objectives were — leading the close on Primal Fangtooth (4-0 at 31.7). But 7 deaths is high, and Serath carried no magic resist into a 3-magical enemy comp (Aurora alone did 33k magic). One resist item makes Serath far harder to delete in the fights the team was already winning.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Best game on the board — 14 kills, 3 deaths, and Willy Guggenheim cleaned up both close-out fights. Eden had the early edge, but Willy flipped it: kills on Eden at 4.7, 10.3, 12 and 14.4 starved their carry before he came online. Keep doing exactly this — farm safe early, then take over once Vanquisher lands.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Crunch was unfavored into Aurora all game and Xeebs wore it (deaths at 5.5, 7.8, 10.4, 14.7 in lane). Xeebs still showed up in the won team fights at 14.4 and 21.9. Like Serath, Crunch took no magic resist into a 3-magical comp — that's why Aurora kept blowing Crunch up. One resist item changes that matchup.

ourKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

fedBy: Tithe of Death (minor): Takedowns restore 15% Max Mana and permanently grant 2 Ability Haste, up to 30 Ability Haste.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,273 hero damage a minute, more than 85% of Gideon mid players this patch (28% of the team's). Penetration did the work: Renna took about 33% more magical damage than their armor allowed (estimate).
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Gideon touched shortened Black Hole, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 66.5s late); fight right after Black Hole is spent.

Tithe of Death (minor): 2 per takedown, 20 takedowns, capped at 30 from the 15th takedown, around 25 min (estimate).
20 takedowns (8 kills, 12 assists) fed: Tithe of Death (minor).

Penetration: Combustion 9, Wraith Leggings 11, Caustica ignores 35%; against Renna (level 17 estimated: about 47 magical armor, 11 after penetration) and Eden (level 17 estimated: about 43 magical armor, 8 after penetration) that is about 33% and 32% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 20.2% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.

sparrow.loadout: Vermis (Serration + Breach), augment Endless Hunt, crest Pacifier
fedBy: Endless Hunt (augment): Takedowns reset Sparrow's Basic Ability Cooldowns and permanently grant 1 Physical Penetration.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,454 hero damage a minute, more than 90% of Sparrow carry players this patch (32% of the team's). The damage came from Storm Breaker, Sky Splitter, Tainted Rounds.
Inner Fire at top rank: 105s base, about 95.5s by the end (9% shorter) from 10 ability haste: Spectra 10.
23 takedowns (14 kills, 9 assists) fed: Endless Hunt (augment).
Sparrow dealt 47,973 hero damage, 32% of their team's, with +172 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Eden (level 17 estimated: about 112 physical armor, 100 after penetration) and Dekker (level 17 estimated: about 111 physical armor, 99 after penetration) that is about 6% and 6% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Storm Breaker (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Release a bolt of lightning that chains to 7 Targets.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Breach (Eternal minor): Ultimate damage reduces an Enemy Hero's Physical Armor by 35% for 4s.

Sustain: 14% lifesteal; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; 3,075 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 5 effects on one trigger: Storm Breaker, Sky Splitter, Spectra, Tainted Rounds, Vermis.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Tainted Rounds, Pacifier.
Stack (Damage that scales with our health): 2 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Serration. The more health a target stacks, the more these deal, so health items on our side fed them.
The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Breach) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; damage that scales with our health), so the same hits paid out twice.

Countered? 2 of the 5 players Sparrow killed built physical armor (Aurora, Bayle). No anti-heal on the team against a build that heals. Health items on Aurora, Bayle raised the %-health damage they took. We killed Sparrow 3 times.

Copy it? Vermis (Serration + Breach): 48.3% in 1,678 Sparrow carry games, below the hero's 50.3%; this 3-item core: 56% in 252 games, level with the 55.6% of that hero-role's cores. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
